verdict.rationale: Adyen for Platforms documents the ability to control seller-facing fees and deduct costs ("Control fees and use payments as a competitive edge," "split the payments...deduct costs as needed") and provides reports for bookkeeping/reconciliation, which supports setting a sell rate and some cost visibility. However, there is no documentation of a specific 'buy rate' pricing structure from Adyen or interchange-level cost breakdowns for managing the spread. Missing for 10: explicit documented buy-rate/interchange pass-through pricing, interchange-level fee reporting granularity, and any pricing transparency docs beyond generic 'control fees' marketing language.
